title: Subagent Runs Log Entry
description: One entry per subagent completion. Written by subagent-error-reporter.js (SubagentStop). Primary diagnostic log for subagent failures and performance.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC. SubagentStop fires at subagent completion.

agentId.description: Subagent runtime ID from SubagentStop hook input (e.g. 'ae326aef21f40e545'). Use this to join with delegation.jsonl — NOTE: delegation.jsonl currently logs agentId as 'unknown', so join must use taskSummary hash until v3 item 4 is implemented.

agentType.description: Resolved agent type. Source priority: (1) delegation.jsonl lookup by agentId via resolveAgentName(), (2) raw agent_type from SubagentStop hook input (historically 'general-purpose' for all agents). Post-v1: should now reflect actual agent name (list, base-research, etc.).

status.description: Outcome classification. 'error': error patterns found and not recovered. 'success': no errors or all recovered. 'empty': subagent returned blank response (likely crash or context limit).

recovered.description: True if error patterns were detected but success patterns were also present, indicating the subagent handled the error internally.

errorCount.description: Number of error pattern matches found in last_assistant_message.

errors.description: Up to 5 error snippet strings from last_assistant_message. Snippets are 100-char substrings around matched error patterns — not full error messages.

structuredError.description: Parsed structured error block if ESCALATION REQUIRED or ERROR REPORT pattern detected. Null if no structured error present.

transcriptPath.description: Absolute path to subagent JSONL transcript from SubagentStop hook input. Null if not provided.

responseLengthChars.description: Character count of last_assistant_message. 0 for empty responses.

consumers: enforce-4d-evaluation.js — detect4dEvaluationFromRunsLog() queries this for 4d-evaluation completions
subagent-error-reporter.js — writes this log and reads delegation.jsonl to resolve agentType
knownLimitations: error snippets are 100-char windows around pattern matches — not full error messages; false positives possible
agentType was historically 'general-purpose' for all entries pre-v1; post-v1 should resolve correctly
recovered=false does not mean unrecovered — it means no SUCCESS_PATTERNS were found alongside errors
